_help._file: How much each thing counts when a goal scores a move (the AI's instincts). Each goal adds these up into its own score; goals.json's bigAt is the bar on that same scale. Change one, then run the AI checks (npm run ai:arena, or the Dev Kit AI tab's Run check) to see what it does to how the personalities play. Read when the AI starts thinking (src/ai/goals/*, decisions.ts, readings.ts).
_help.TRAP: Hunting a rival glyphling: per move cut from it, a tangle, own pieces near it, nearly trapped, hexes taken, cast spots taken, siege pieces round a cornered one, threats cut, ending the game while behind (a big minus).
_help.SCORE: Spelling: per letter past 4, each extra word in the same turn.
_help.DENY: Blocking a rival's best spot: extra when the seed played there is a junk letter anyway.
_help.ESCAPE: Getting out of danger: per danger point dropped, per route out, per open direction, too few routes (minus), tangling itself (big minus), per hex kept.
_help.BUILD: Setting up its own words: per setup, per own seed near, per frame letter it fills, per rival letter in the frame (minus).
_help.STEAL: Growing a rival's word into its own: per rival seed used, share of the Magic, owning the majority.
_help.DUMP: Getting rid of a junk letter: bonus for dumping it far from every glyphling, and how far counts as far (hexes).
_help.SELFTANGLE: The Survivor's own trick, tangling itself on purpose when it pays: the tangle, per rival piece there, per move closer, per rival piece near, another glyphling left cornered (minus), ending the game (big minus).
_help.draft: Placing glyphlings at the start: per move of room, per hex from the centre (minus), per hex from the nearest rival (scaled by caution − aggression).
_help.magicPerPoint: Magic per point of the 'behind' / 'ahead' readings (0–10) that the personalities' mood shifts use.
